result.title: Fix Where It Fails: Root-Cause-Guided Agentic Harness Optimization for Scene Graph Generation
result.summary: Scene graph generation (SGG) aims to detect objects in an image and predict the relationships between them. The standard PredCls, SGCls, and SGDet settings show how much performance drops without ground-truth boxes and labels, but not where or why a model fails. Knowing this would allow fixing a model where it fails, without retraining. We propose RoHa-SGG (Root-cause-guided Harness optimization for SGG), which extends agentic harness optimization to SGG. It optimizes the harness, the inference code around a frozen SGG model. RoHa-SGG has two main LLM agents. A root-cause analysis (RCA) agent finds the components where the model fails and diagnoses why, and a proposer agent searches for a harness that fixes these causes. We evaluate RoHa-SGG on Visual Genome and PSG with representative two-stage, one-stage, and multimodal-LLM SGG models. The analysis shows that the components where ground-truth triplets are lost differ across models and datasets. RoHa-SGG improves every metric on all five model-dataset combinations. Graph-constrained R@100 and mR@100 rise by up to 15.8 and 26.4 points for the multimodal LLM and by up to 3.6 and 10.1 points for the two-stage and one-stage models. With root-cause guidance, the harness search reaches the final score of an unguided search up to three times faster.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RoHa-SGG，用根因分析 agent 定位冻结 SGG 模型在哪些组件丢失真值三元组及原因，再由提议 agent 搜索推理代码（harness）修改，在 Visual Genome 和 PSG 上免训练提升多种 SGG 模型。
AI.relevance_reason: SGG 属结构化视觉关系推理，其跨模型/数据集的失败组件归因与推理期 harness 优化，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据保留、失败定位和外部计算分配提供诊断线索；但方法不涉及 latent 推理状态，需核查其根因分析能否迁移。
